summary: Backend smoke tests for AgendaBella (auth, professionals, services, availability, slots, bookings, payments, admin). All 13 targeted areas verified against public URL. 24/24 backend checks pass.
passed: POST /api/auth/login admin returns 200 with role=admin and token
POST /api/services (profissional) creates service; GET /api/services/mine lists it; DELETE /api/services/{id} works
POST /api/availability creates entry; GET /api/availability/mine lists; DELETE /api/availability/{id} works
GET /api/professionals/{id}/slots?date=&service_id= returns {slots, service_duration, service_price} with 30-min grid respected
POST /api/bookings creates booking with status=pending_payment and deposit=30% of price
POST /api/bookings second identical request returns 409 (slot conflict)
POST /api/payments/checkout returns 200 with checkout_url + session_id (Stripe test)
GET /api/bookings/mine scoped: cliente sees own bookings, admin sees all
POST /api/bookings/{id}/cancel updates status to cancelled (permission enforced)
action_items: Minor: booking payload field is start_time (not time) and slot response is {slots:[...], service_duration, service_price} — ensure frontend uses these exact names.
Minor: profissional availability listing endpoint is GET /api/availability/mine (not GET /api/availability, which is 405). Confirm frontend uses /mine.
Booking response deposit field is `deposit` (not `deposit_amount`). Confirm frontend key naming.
